row.primary_outcome: Composite of necrotizing enterocolitis (Bell stage IIa or higher), moderate to severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, or death at 36 weeks postmenstrual age (noninferiority)
row.primary_outcome_source: Methods: The primary outcome was a composite of necrotizing enterocolitis (defined as Bell stage IIa or higher), moderate to severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, or death at 36 weeks postmenstrual age.
row.anchor_as_printed: A primary-outcome event occurred in 63 of 136 infants (46.3%) in the expectant-management group and in 87 of 137 (63.5%) in the early-ibuprofen group (absolute risk difference, -17.2 percentage points; upper boundary of the one-sided 95% confidence interval [CI], -7.4; P<0.001 for noninferiority)
row.notes: BeNeDuctus, NEJM 2023 (the meta label year 2022 is the online-first year)
